prompt.alinti: One free endpoint replaced a wall of paid API keys.
34 free LLM providers behind one OpenAI-compatible URL.
635 endpoints, including Groq, Gemini and Mistral and Cerebras.
Swap one base URL, keep your code, and it auto-rotates when a free tier hits its cap.
Runs locally, one command, ~7.4B free tokens a month.
One OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint sits in front of 34 free provider tiers.
Point your existing OpenAI client at it, keep your code, and every request is routed to a free model behind the scenes.
It tracks every provider's rate limits and failover per key. When one free tier hits its cap or returns a 429, it rotates to the next provider automatically.
Nothing breaks and you never pay.
